verdict.rationale: Sentry has a dedicated first-party Webhooks page in its Integration Platform docs (sentry-docs-25), which indicates that external systems and agents can subscribe to Sentry events. Its alerting and notification integrations (sentry-docs-17, 18, 19) and the API and third-party integrations on paid plans (sentry-docs-11) support the same event-delivery story. The evidence is little more than page titles, though, so the details are unverified. Missing for 10: documented list of subscribable event types, payload schemas, signature verification and retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery.
